ANONYMOUS (ANON-C)	1994197816	      A changed or reinforced or chemically modified version of a recyclable material can be added in precise concentration doses to tag (per S.A.E. or other industry convention) batch lots of material as auto industry reclaim or as otherwise unique.  JIANG X;  XU Y;  XU F;  SONG J;  ZHOU L	HUIZHOU EVE ENERGY GATHERING CO LTD (EVNE-C)	202448314M	   NOVELTY - Detecting metal impurity particles of lithium                battery material, involves adding proper amount of                sample and solvent into the polytetrafluoroethylene                barrel; using the plastic thin tube to cover the                magnetic rod, then using the heat sealing machine                to seal the plastic thin tube covered with the                magnetic rod, and then putting the magnetic rod                containing plastic thin tube into the                polytetrafluoroethylene barrel; sealing the sample,                solvent, the polytetrafluoroethylene barrel of the                magnetic rod and placing in a tank mill for mixing,                after finishing, taking out magnetic rod, peeling                off plastic thin pipe from magnetic rod, placing in                a clean beaker, adding de-ionized water, using                ultrasonic cleaning instrument for ultrasonic                treatment, until there is no residue on the plastic                thin pipe, taking out the plastic tube from the                beaker; purifying sample, using small magnetic rod                to surround the bottom of the cup wall of the                beaker, absorbing and collecting metal particles at                bottom of beaker.    USE - Method for detecting metal impurity particles                of lithium battery material.    ADVANTAGE - The method can effectively and completely                identify the presence of impurity particles in the                lithium electric material, comprising simple                substance, the compound or mixture, and the                information such as element type, shape, provide                direct and accurate location for the short circuit                point-metal impurity particle traceability                influencing the self-discharge of the electric                core, and form the advantage complementation with                the inductive coupled plasma (ICP) detection, as                the important measure of the metal impurity control                in the current lithium electric production.    DETAILED DESCRIPTION - Detecting metal impurity particles of lithium                battery material, involves adding proper amount of                sample and solvent into the polytetrafluoroethylene                barrel; using the plastic thin tube to cover the                magnetic rod, then using the heat sealing machine                to seal the plastic thin tube covered with the                magnetic rod, and then putting the magnetic rod                containing the plastic thin tube into the                polytetrafluoroethylene barrel; sealing the sample,                solvent, the polytetrafluoroethylene barrel of the                magnetic rod and then placing in a tank mill for                mixing, after finishing, taking out the magnetic                rod, peeling off the plastic thin pipe from the                magnetic rod, then placing in a clean beaker,                adding de-ionized water, using ultrasonic cleaning                instrument for ultrasonic treatment, until there is                no residue on the plastic thin pipe, taking out the                plastic tube from the beaker; purifying the sample,                using a small magnetic rod to surround the bottom                of the cup wall of the beaker, absorbing and                collecting the metal particles at the bottom of the                beaker, pouring the solution, repeating the process                until the solution is clear; extracting the metal                particles, mounting the filter paper in the filter                bottle of the filter device, pouring the clear                solution containing the metal particles to filter                until there is no obvious bead on the surface of                the filter paper, then adding                carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) glue solution, fixing                on the slide; energy dispersive X-Ray spectroscopy                (EDS) component analysis, after cutting the filter                film containing impurity particles, using                conductive adhesive to adhere on the EDS object                stage, firstly performing metal spraying treatment,                then performing EDS component analysis. An                embossing area (24) is situated outside the coil                (26) and inside the coil (28). The coil (28) is                situated at a card`s periphery and the coil (26) is                situated in a card`s rectangular part. An                insulating glue e.g. MK55 glue, is deposited on the                film. The glue has a softening temperature that                does not differ from a maximum temperature of hot                lamination cycle of a plastic structure of the                card, by more than 40 degrees. The glue is viscous                at the maximum temperature.    USE - Smartcard e.g. contactless tag and flip chip,                used in banking application, radiofrequency                identification and traceability applications.    ADVANTAGE - The embossing area is situated outside one of                the coils of the antenna and inside the other coil                of the antenna, thus optimizing equivalent surface                of the antenna in spite of the presence of the                embossing area. The magnetic antenna is placed on                the flexible film having the thickness comprised                between 40 and 100 micrometers, thus resisting                bending stresses applied on the card and reducing                deformation phenomena during the operation of                lamination of a plastic structure of the card. The                flexible film resists temperatures greater than 100                degrees, while avoiding embedding of the                microcircuit in the structure, during lamination                operation, thus further limiting damages of a land                and the coils of the antenna. The insulating glue                is viscous at the maximum temperature and has the                softening temperature that is not less than 40                degrees of the maximum temperature of hot                lamination cycle of the plastic structure of the                card, so that the glue does not flow in an                excessive manner, during the lamination of the                plastic structure, thus preventing damage to                connections between the microcircuit and the land.                The coils are arranged such that a surface                comprised inside the coils is maximized, and hence                the performance of the antenna is optimized.    DETAILED DESCRIPTION - An INDEPENDENT CLAIM is also included for a                method for manufacturing a smartcard. A regulator (304) regulates                supply of airflow to the die head of the extruder                (110). The control unit determines a deviation                between the measured attributes received from the                inspection unit and corresponding predefined                attributes stored within the control unit. The attributes comprise an                inner diameter, an outer diameter, a wall                thickness, and an ovality or roundness of the                extruded tube, or a surface quality or smoothness                of the extruded tube or puncture. USE - System for controlling airflow in extruder                used in plastics and polymer industries for                extruding tubes, films, sheets, profiles and                cables.    ADVANTAGE - The system ensures that a controlled and                consistent airflow is maintained within the                extruded tube as the semi-solid tube exits the                extrusion die head, by preventing the collapse of                the tube walls. The extruded tube is delivered                onto the conveyor unit , which transports the                extruded tube at a consistent, controlled rate,                ensuring production uniformity and minimizing the                risk of stretching or deformation. The system                enables immediate corrective action via real-time                comparison of tube attributes against threshold                values, to adjust the attributes of the subsequent                tubes to be extruded to significantly reduce                material wastage, running downtime and enhances                process stability.  TANG X;  JIANG W;  SHA X;  TU Z	UNIV JIANGXI NORMAL (UYJX-C)	2023266142	   NOVELTY - Identifying carp fish gelatin involves (a)                establishing theoretical characteristic peptide                database of carps gelatin by extracting amino acid                sequence of carps type I collagen from the NCBI                database, and establishing common characteristics                of carps gelatin were by using protein sequence                alignment software combined with                collagenase-trypsin combination simulation                digestion (number of missing cut sites is set to                0-2) and unique characteristic peptide database;                and (b) pre-treating carp scales by washing scales                of 7 kinds of carps collected with clear water to                remove dirt and mucus on the surface of the scales,                using a tissue grinder for 5-10 minutes to remove                the silvery substance on the surface of the fish                scales, and washing with water, and using                0.2-1.0mol/L hydrogen chloride (HCl) solution to                decalcify fish scales at a ratio of 1:5-1:20 (w/v)                for 0.5-3.0 hours, pouring out the acid solution,                and then washing the fish scales with water until                pH value is 5.5-7.0.    USE - Method for identifying carp fish                gelatin.    ADVANTAGE - The method identifies carp fish gelatin, which                improves accuracy, authenticity of traceability and                identification of carps gelatin.    DETAILED DESCRIPTION - Identifying carp fish gelatin involves (a)                establishing theoretical characteristic peptide                database of carps gelatin by extracting amino acid                sequence of carps type I collagen from the NCBI                database, and establishing common characteristics                of carps gelatin were by using protein sequence                alignment software combined with                collagenase-trypsin combination simulation                digestion (the number of missing cut sites is set                to 0-2) and unique characteristic peptide database;                (b) pre-treating carp scales by washing scales of 7                kinds of carps collected with clear water to remove                dirt and mucus on the surface of the scales, using                a tissue grinder for 5-10 minutes to remove the                silvery substance on the surface of the fish                scales, and washing with water, and using                0.2-1.0mol/L hydrogen chloride (HCl) solution to                decalcify fish scales at a ratio of 1:5-1:20 (w/v)                for 0.5-3.0 hours, pouring out the acid solution,                and then washing the fish scales with water until                the pH value is 5.5-7.0; (c) extracting carp fish                scale gelatin by adding deionized water to the                pre-treated fish scales, covering with plastic                wrap, heating in water bath at 50-100&#176;C                for 1-6 hours, filtering and freeze-drying fish                gelatin solution to obtain carp fish scale gelatin;                (d) performing enzymatic hydrolysis of carp fish                scale gelatin by dissolving dried fish scale                gelatin sample in SDT buffer to make 1-10mg/mL fish                gelatin solution, heating it in a water bath at                80-100&#176;C for 2-10 minutes, centrifuging,                putting the supernatant in a 10-20kDa                ultrafiltration centrifuge tube, adding                100-300&#956;L UA buffer, placing it in a                centrifuge, adding UA buffer and centrifuging it                again, repeating it for 1-3 times, adding                100-200&#956;l of UA buffer solution of                50-100mmol/L iodoacetic acid, and placing it in a                dark room for 10-60 minutes, and centrifuging it at                3000-10000 revolutions per minute (rpm) for 10-30                minutes to obtain a gelatin concentrate; dissolving                the gelatin concentrate in 250-300&#956;L of                activation buffer, adding 2-3&#956;L of 1mg/mL                collagenase, standing at 30-45&#176;C                overnight, centrifuging, collecting the filtrate,                and obtaining the first enzymatic hydrolysis                product, and then adding 100-200&#956;L of UA                buffer solution to the first enzymatic hydrolysis                product, and placing it in a dark room for 10-60                minutes, and then centrifuging it at a speed of                3000-10000 rpm for 10-30 minutes, adding                1-2&#956;L of 1mg/mL trypsin, standing it                overnight at 30-45&#176;C, centrifuging,                collecting the filtrate, and obtaining the second                enzymatic hydrolysis product; (e) loading second                enzymatic hydrolysis product on Easy nLC-Orbitrap                Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer for detection,                injecting it into C18 chromatographic column, using                mobile phase A containing 0.1-0.5 % (v/v) formic                acid in water, mobile phase B is acetonitrile                solution containing 0.1-0.5% (v/v) formic acid                (acetonitrile content is 70-95% and rest is water)                at a flow rate of 200-300nl/minutes, carrying out                elution for 40-90 minutes, where linear gradient                changes from mobile phase A to mobile phase B,                using data-dependent acquisition mode to                dynamically collect the 5-20 parent ions with the                highest abundance for HCD cracking, where dynamic                exclusion time is 10-20 seconds and collision                energy is 20-30eV, and recording the obtained mass                spectrogram, where recorded mass spectrogram                include a primary mass spectrogram and a secondary                mass spectrogram; (f) using MASCOT software to                match and analyze the mass spectrograms obtained,                and database is set to the target collagen                database, where search parameters include cysteine                which is fixed and modified by iodoacetamide, and                oxidation is a possible modification, where the                largest uncut site is 1-5, error rate of primary                mass spectrometry is &#177;(10-30)ppm, and                secondary mass spectrometry error rate is                &#177;(0.1-0.5)Da, and when Mascot score is                greater than 40 then peptide peak is considered to                be positively identified or the accuracy is                extremely high (P &lt; 0.05); and (g)                identifying source of carps gelatin by matching                common characteristic peptides of 7 kinds of carps                gelatin identified database and their own unique                characteristic peptide database based on the mass                spectrometry detection results and the common and                unique theoretical characteristic peptide database                of carps gelatin established in step (a), and then                species of carp gelatin is accurately                identified.
